title: Evaluations & rollout
summary: Measure real outcomes before expanding automation or claiming savings.

sections.label: Baseline
sections.text: Use representative historical tasks with reviewed expected outcomes. Evaluate retrieval, analysis, execution, and resulting state, not whether the agent sounds confident.

sections.label: Rollout
sections.text: Measure the current approach, try a bounded task, inspect outcomes and expand only where evidence supports it. Use shadow evaluation when comparing a new decision component without changing live behavior. A Jev source-support experiment is one optional example.

sections.label: Gap review: workflow use and checks
items: Recommended use: Build a baseline, inspect outcomes and decide whether a bounded rollout is supported.
Freeze representative cases and acceptance criteria before comparing candidates.
Retain traces and end-state evidence, including failures and unrun checks.
Workflow placement and checks are Atlas recommendations. Existing examples, tenant availability, older product claims and comparative benefits were not revalidated by this mapping review.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
